observation: [agent_pos, target_pos, opponent_pos, normalized_step, dist_target, dist_opponent, bias, slip_prob]
preprocessing: All positions and distances normalized to [0,1]; bias term included.
reward: +1.0 for reaching target, -1.0 if caught, -0.01 per step, small shaping toward target.
termination: Target reached, opponent catches agent, or max_steps reached.
opponent: Greedy one-step move toward agent with stochastic slip/no-move probability.
stochasticity: Initial positions and action slip controlled by seeded NumPy RNG.

observation: [resources, workers, soldiers, base_health, enemy_pressure, normalized_step, last_wave, cooldown, stockpile_ratio, defense_ratio, bias]
preprocessing: Counts and health normalized to fixed caps; bias term included.
reward: Incremental reward for survival, soldiers, and pressure reduction; penalties for base damage and defeat; terminal win bonus if base survives.
opponent: Seeded enemy pressure process with stochastic waves; pressure damages base unless countered by soldiers/attack actions.
stochasticity: Initial stockpile, enemy wave arrivals, and wave magnitudes controlled by seeded NumPy RNG.

observation: Discrete grid state encoded as a 16-dimensional one-hot vector.
preprocessing: Gymnasium discrete observation converted to one-hot vector; no additional feature engineering.
action: Discrete, 4 actions: left, down, right, up.
reward: +1.0 for reaching the goal, 0 otherwise; slippery transition dynamics enabled.
termination: Goal reached, hole reached, or Gymnasium time-limit truncation.
opponent: No opponent; environment transition model is stochastic because the slippery map changes intended motion.
stochasticity: Gymnasium reset seed and slippery transition dynamics.

observation: Discrete grid state encoded as a 48-dimensional one-hot vector.
preprocessing: Gymnasium discrete observation converted to one-hot vector; no additional feature engineering.
action: Discrete, 4 actions: up, right, down, left.
reward: -1 per step and -100 for stepping into the cliff; episode ends at the goal.
termination: Goal reached or Gymnasium time-limit truncation.
opponent: No opponent; deterministic grid transition dynamics.
stochasticity: Gymnasium reset seed; transition dynamics are deterministic.

observation: Partial-observation MiniGrid dictionary with 7x7x3 symbolic image and agent direction.
preprocessing: Image and direction fields flattened and normalized; mission string omitted from the numeric policy input.
action: Discrete, 7 MiniGrid actions: left, right, forward, pickup, drop, toggle, done.
reward: MiniGrid sparse goal reward with built-in time penalty; zero for non-goal transitions.
termination: Goal reached or MiniGrid time-limit truncation.
opponent: No opponent; partial observability and randomized start/goal placement define task variation.
stochasticity: MiniGrid reset seed controls layout/start orientation and any environment randomization.
